title: 8-to-1 multiplexer (concurrent SOP, nested-loop exhaustive TB)
problemDescription: 8-to-1 mux: y = x(to_integer(unsigned(sel))). Reference TB sweeps every combination of sel ∈ [0,7] and x ∈ [0,255] at 2 ns each — 2048 transitions, ~4096 ns total. autoStimulus derives the input transitions from GHDL's golden VCD; transcribing the nested loops by hand would be error-prone.
